'''Chainguns''' were extremely powerful ranged weapons that fired small [[Blaster/Legends|blaster bolts]] at a very high volume, and at extremely high speeds. The sound of a chaingun would horrify targets, as hundreds of blaster bolts struck their bodies. Chainguns made short work of large groups of opponents, and operated off an automatically recharging power source. However, it was a large, heavy, and unwieldy weapon.

==History==
[[File:GalacticMarineChaingun-BFII.jpg|thumb|left|A [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marine]] using a [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 chaingun]]]]
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] used the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon/Legends|Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One of these rotating [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] chainguns was used in battle against [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Hypori/Legends|Hypori]]. The weapon had two configurations: Shoulder mounted, like a [[Missile launcher/Legends|Rocket launcher]], or a two-handed configuration. The shoulder-mounted version was used by the [[Rail-class Advanced Recon Commando]] variant of [[Anti-trooper]]. Another chaingun was the [[LS-150 Heavy Accelerated Charged Particle Repeater Gun]], used by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] mercenaries on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. Most variants of [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|Phase II Dark Troopers]] used chainguns in battle. The Rebel SpecForces team [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]] also used chainguns.

==Use==
[[File:Hardcase_Force_Collection.png|thumb|right|200px|Clone trooper [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] uses a Z-6 cannon during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]]]
The chaingun was often used for capturing fortified bases or for charging a closely knit force of hostiles, as its devastating rate of fire would both intimidate and eliminate enemies. The chaingun was also highly effective at defending an area. However, they were not usually wielded for general use, as the chaingun was large and heavy, and some models needed a few seconds to warm up before firing.

[[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] also carried a chaingun in a box on his back and used it to defend a [[Unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|planet]].
